scene: The flyer lists three transit hubs departing from this very roof edge.
picture: Flat side view. Along one rooftop ground line: on the far left hangs a striped window-cleaner gondola. The player stands left of centre holding a steaming mug and reading the pinned flyer on the star-shaped cart. In the centre waits a red pneumatic mail train. On the far right, a yellow tow truck hovers.
shown: a striped window-cleaner gondola swinging empty on ropes on the far left
a tiny red pneumatic mail train idling on tracks in the centre
a yellow flying tow truck hovering by the curb on the far right
